## Editor's Brief

The last 24 hours reveal a multipolar security landscape defined by accelerating materiel buildups, drone warfare intensification, and strategic realignments. Taiwan’s plan to amass 1,850 anti-ship missiles by 2029 signals a deliberate 'kill-zone' strategy against a potential Chinese invasion, while Ukraine demonstrates the power of deep-strike drones by hitting a Russian corvette near Saint Petersburg and 18 oil/gas facilities inside Russia. The U.S. is exploring unprecedented allied shipbuilding from Japan and South Korea to relieve industrial base constraints, while the Marine Corps tests novel anti-drone rifle rounds. Convergent themes: missile proliferation, drone ubiquity, and the erosion of traditional naval deterrence.
